map.训练计划生成是做什么的？: What does Personalized Training Plan Generator do?
map.如何使用训练计划生成？: How do I use Personalized Training Plan Generator?
map.训练计划生成适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Personalized Training Plan Generator best for?
map.基于你的目标和水平生成专属训练计划: Generate a tailored training plan from your goal and level
map.渐进负荷：周增量 ≤ 10%；容量 = 次数×组数×重量: Progressive overload: weekly increase <= 10%; volume = reps × sets × weight
map.个性化训练计划按目标、水平与可用时间生成：以容量(次数×组数×重量)为基线，每周: A personalized training plan is generated from goal, level and available time: using volume (reps × sets × weight) as the baseline, weekly progression is kept within 10%, and exercises, sets/reps and progression tempo are arranged automatically.
map.备赛期按周量与强度分布自动生成周期化计划，保证渐进超负荷且有减量周。: During a competition block, automatically generate a periodized plan from weekly volume and intensity distribution, ensuring progressive overload with deload weeks.
map.减脂：每周 4 次有氧+2 次力量+1 柔韧；增肌：分化训练 5 次。: Fat loss: 4 cardio + 2 strength + 1 flexibility sessions per week; muscle gain: 5 split sessions.
map.计划多久调？: How often should the plan be adjusted?
map.4–6 周按反馈微调。: Fine-tune every 4-6 weeks based on feedback.
map.计划里的强度区间怎么定？: How are the intensity zones in the plan set?
map.一般基于储备心率或乳酸阈划分，再按周期目标分配各区间周占比。: They are usually defined by heart-rate reserve or lactate threshold, then allocated weekly shares according to the block's goal.
map.训练计划生成。体育竞技工具，帮助计算与分析运动数据。: A personalized training plan generator. A sports tool that helps calculate and analyze athletic data.
map.基于你的目标、水平和单次可用时间生成单周训练计划: Build a single-week plan from your goal, level and available session time.
map.训练计划生成（纯查表生成器）：按训练部位取分化表前 N 天（N=每周天数 3–6: Plan generation (pure lookup): take the first N days of the split table (N = 3-6 days per week; each focus has 6 day templates); session time decides how many exercises per body part (45 min → 2, 60 → 3, 90 → 4); sets/reps come from the exercise × level lookup table; duplicate exercise names within a day are removed; the result summarizes exercises and total sets. This page does not compute training weights or multi-week periodization/deload.
map.按目标、水平与单次可用时间生成单周动作与组次安排：从固定动作库按经验等级查表取组: Generate a single-week exercise and sets/reps plan from goal, level and available session time: sets/reps are looked up by level from a fixed exercise library, duplicate names are removed, and total sets are summed. No weight percentages or multi-week periodization/deload are produced.
map.按目标/水平/单次可用时间排单周计划。: Plan a single week by goal, level and available session time.
map.单周排期：按部位与每周天数生成 3–6 天分化安排；多周周期化、减量周与本页无关: Single-week scheduling: generate a 3-6 day split by focus and days per week; multi-week periodization and deload weeks are outside this tool and must be planned separately.
map.计划里的重量和强度区间怎么定？: How are weights and intensity zones set?
map.本工具只给动作与组次，不计算重量百分比或心率区间。重量应按个人 1RM 的百分比: This tool only provides exercises and sets/reps; it does not compute weight percentages or heart-rate zones. Set weights by %1RM or RPE and adjust after 4-6 weeks based on feedback.
